title: The hidden costs of resilience: Financing the new supply chain reality
executive_summary: The video discusses the repricing of supply chains due to geopolitics, tariffs, and disruptions, leading companies to carry higher inventory levels and build liquidity buffers. The conversation highlights structural changes in supply chain financing and capital allocation strategies.

asset_allocation_views: increasing allocation to supply chain finance
profile_data.market_outlook: The market is expected to see a structural shift in supply chain financing and capital allocation strategies, with a focus on building resilience and managing risks.
